PR02: Headless presentation state and commands

Add a typed, immutable, listenable presentation state and a typed command
facade for Flutter presentation code, backed by a UI-state coordinator that
owns the default shell's presentation state.

- plate_presentation_state.dart: PlateEditorPresentationState snapshot and
  PlatePresentationController (ValueListenable) binding, published from the
  committed session/controller/coordinator only on actual state change.
- plate_presentation_commands.dart: 25-method typed facade delegating to the
  existing controller/session/support owners; controller-backed commands throw
  StateError after Plate disposal, UI-context commands report disabled.
- plate_presentation_ui_coordinator.dart: shell UI state owner (inspector
  visibility/enablement, drawers, multi-select, file actions) with delegate
  attach/detach; shell detaches in deactivate so composition transitions keep
  the mounted shell's delegate.
- plate.dart/plate_layout.dart/plate_default_editor_shell.dart: wire the
  coordinator and presentation binding through Plate and the default shell;
  PlateLayoutContext gains an optional presentation controller.
- barrel: re-export the frozen curated PlateElement family (27 names) plus
  PlateEditorPresentationState, PlatePresentationCommands,
  PlatePresentationController.
- Specs: element models are data contracts; callers may inspect/construct/
  pattern-match/patch them; JSON/codec/schema-adapter imports stay forbidden.
- Tests: state publish semantics, command delegation/undo/redo/viewport/
  template/export, shell delegate attach, element public API, boundary guards,
  layout presentation observations.
